speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Under the Enabling Masterplan, this refers to those with physical, sensory, intellectual and developmental impairments.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: To manage mental health issues at work, our efforts have been to educate companies to be more aware of how work stress may lead to mental health issues and, of course, to implement progressive practices that they can adopt to help employees manage stress, whether from work or non-work factors.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: For instance, the Health Promotion Board (HPB) provides onsite Management Training workshops to equip managers and human resource professionals with skills to recognise employees with common mental health issues, including stress, and to support employees in managing them.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: HPB has also made available workplace mental health programmes that give practical tips to workers on effective stress management.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: The Workplace Safety and Health Institute's research on work stress aims to help the Ministry of Manpower and companies understand employees' perceptions of stress, what it could be linked to and how it impacts their well-being.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: The research will help in educating and socialising companies to be more aware of the effects of stress.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: This recognises the diverse workforce and employers, where rigid prescriptions are unlikely to be effective or may deter employers from hiring.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: To help workers and employers deal with the challenges of mental health at the workplace, we will continue to raise awareness, step up education and share best practices.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: And that is how we define persons with disabilities or persons with special needs.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: We do make a distinction, similar to how we distinguish physical disability versus, for example, diabetes or someone with chronic illness.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: But again, as I said, there are schemes to help those with mental health concerns or issues to find them employment, for example, through the Job Club at IMH.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: But rest assured that we will help them and get employers more aware of this issue.

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
text: Actually, my concern is not so much the help that the person is getting but the support that we give to employers, which is really what the SEC and ODP are about.

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
text: I am involved in the social enterprise Hush where we employ persons in recovery and with mental conditions.

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
text: The effort has not been a walk in the park.

speaker: Ms Anthea Ong
text: A lot of effort needs to be put in.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Perhaps, the Member is not aware of the objective of the schemes.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: The SEC and ODP are both meant for persons with special needs, classified as disabled, and is an impairment for them.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: For persons with mental health conditions, as I mentioned, we do have programmes to help them with employability.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: It provides not just employment facilitation, but it also has some social workers there.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: You have occupational therapists there as well to provide relevant support for them to be engaged in the workforce.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: So, this is something that, if the Member has, I suppose, persons with mental conditions that need to be employed, talk to us.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: We will try to see how we can work things out with Adapt and Grow.
